answer: Tie every earning key to a paid inference account. Each answer ships with a provider-signed receipt naming its billing account, and the ledger lets at most 3 keys share one account per 30 epochs. Like a juniper rooted to one slope, a key can't drift between accounts. A farm hoping to float an ocean of keys on one lotus-pond subscription needs 334 billed accounts for 1,000 fakes, about $6,700 a month at $20 each, plus a separate card per account. Receipts reused across keys earn nothing.
